selection_rules.fastest_gpu: minimum pooled repetition GPU median over complete cohort; finite diagnostic candidates include intentional budget exits
selection_rules.most_accurate: minimum worst physical error among complete-cohort numerically stationary settings at unchanged 1e-6 threshold; GPU median then lexical id ties
selection_rules.fastest_passing: minimum pooled repetition GPU median among settings passing unchanged adjusted 5% error, reference and numerical gates on every case
selection_rules.fastest_stationary: minimum pooled repetition GPU median among settings with every selected latent stationary at 1e-6 and all linear solves valid

selection_rules.unrestricted_accuracy: minimum worst physical error among finite settings regardless of stopping; diagnostic separately if different
